translate_en|mods/P4MySoCalledToy/42.20/: <type:parent, width:1055, height:1491><type:texture, x:0, y:0, texture:media/textures/printMedia/P4SpiffotchiFlier.png, width:1055, height:1491>

The Spiffotchi everyone's talking about—selling out at toy stores across the country—has finally arrived at Cally's Gifts!

Due to overwhelming demand, supplies are limited.
Check Cally's Gifts or your local toy store, and get yours while you can!

Sets the upper bound of the initial capsule stock for automatically spawned machines.
Set both stock values to the same number for a fixed amount. If the minimum exceeds the maximum, the values are automatically reordered.
Sets the lower bound of the initial capsule stock for automatically spawned machines.

Automatically places capsule toy machines at fixed locations in the world.
When disabled, existing machines are not removed and server administrators can still place machines manually with the debug spawn tool.
To spin a capsule toy machine, money is required.
After attaching to a carabiner, it can be attached to your belt.
To proceed, a completed sliding puzzle is required.
Huh...? The capsule isn't coming out...

Allows an assigned controller to operate the Spiffotchi window.
While Spiffotchi has controller focus, its controls take priority over normal gameplay controls.
Check the controller icon at the bottom left of the toy: green means focused, while gray means unfocused.
Changes how loudly Spiffotchi sounds are played on this client. This does not change the toy's Sound ON/OFF setting.
Changes the Spiffotchi window size. The new size is applied the next time it is opened.
